name: v3_cylinder
_doc: M2 gate V3 — flow past a cylinder (Cd/St, Re=100 & 200) + open-channel BCs. RESEARCH §10 V3 / research/11 §4. Cylinder surface is NO-SLIP (resolved BL at D=32); free-slip solids are also implemented (RESEARCH §3) but cannot shed or reach Cd≈1.33. re100.record_samples=16384 gives a ~39-shedding-cycle FFT window (dt≈0.469, T_shed≈197.5), clearing the PLAN's ≥20-cycle requirement.
